name: Laser wall
goalName: How to make a laser wall in Unity?
goal: The game needs a laser wall, consisting of multiple lasers, acting like a wall and a hazard. It should be movable as well.

result: As seen in the video below, the laser wall emits light. It also follows a set path, with a set speed, following customisable waypoints. Developers can mark a movement type when the last waypoint is reached, to stop it, loop, or ping pong back. The wall has a collider that acts like a wall and one for triggering a damage event (needs to be in the PlayerController script).<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/lF5MPu7vJJo>>
validation: My fellow peers validated the component, as well as a teacher.
contribution: Now the laser wall is finished, I will proceed with making a blender model for a hanging turret. The component is ready to be used in the level design.
